value.rationale: The result turns a numerically displayed viability surface into an exact tradeoff between contamination intensity and contaminated-forager return. It identifies a contamination floor below which R1 cannot drop below one even at p=0, proves monotone comparative statics, and gives the limiting return requirement at arbitrarily large contamination. These are natural threshold quantities for the source model and reproduce its published transition values exactly.
